name: retinoic acid receptor alpha

function.text: RARA encodes retinoic acid receptor alpha. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of miRNA transcription.

function.text: RARA encodes retinoic acid receptor alpha. Based in part on similarity, the RXR/RAR heterodimers bind to the retinoic acid response elements (RARE) composed of tandem 5'-AGGTCA-3' sites known as DR1-DR5. RARA plays an essential role in the regulation of retinoic acid-induced germ cell development during spermatogenesis. It has a role in the survival of early spermatocytes at the beginning prophase of meiosis.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving RARA have been reported in acute promyelocytic leukemia.
